name: local_courseplanner_setup
description: Walkthrough for the Course calendar setup page (local_courseplanner).

steps.title: Welcome to Course Calendar setup
steps.content:
This page is your setup hub for the course calendar. It now adapts to where you are in the setup process instead of forcing you through a fixed wizard.

You can re-run this walkthrough any time by clicking the Show walkthrough button next to the page heading.

steps.title: Recommended next step
steps.content:
This card is the best place to start. It looks at your current state and suggests the next useful action: create a blueprint, link this course, add topics, create a course calendar, or open the recommended calendar.

When more than one course calendar exists, the recommendation favors the active calendar and then calendar dates that best match the course and current year.

steps.title: Course blueprint
steps.content:
A blueprint is your reusable master list of topics for a class. This section shows which blueprint this Moodle course is using and lets you change or unlink it.

The linked-blueprint row is intentionally compact, with the unlink action aligned to the right like the course calendar rows.

steps.title: Course calendars
steps.content:
Course calendars are the week-by-week schedules students actually see. You can keep multiple calendars for this course, but only one should be active at a time.

Use the recommended or active row to open the builder. The Create new course calendar control lives at the bottom of the list so existing calendars stay easy to scan first.

steps.title: Blueprint library
steps.content:
Blueprints live here. Create one blueprint per class you teach - topics you add to it will be available on every future course calendar built from it. Only you can edit the blueprints you own.

The create-new form is placed after the list, matching the rest of the app's list-first pattern.

steps.title: Blueprint topics
steps.content:
Topics are the lectures, labs, eLessons, tests, and homework that make up a class. Add them once to the blueprint and they are available on every course calendar using it.

Use Import Topics to seed topics from pasted HTML. Topic content uses Moodle's standard editor, and topic-block cells in the builder can now edit the shared topic directly with a clear warning.

steps.title: You're ready to go
steps.content:
Once your blueprint has topics and a course calendar is created, open the builder from the recommended action or the calendar row to arrange topics into weeks.

Any time you want a refresher, click this Show walkthrough button to run the tour again.
